title: Structured add-ons experiment: metered observability, compliance questionnaire add-on, and tiered SLA pricing
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: Sales and Solutions Engineering report repeated asks from mid-market and enterprise prospects for: (1) longer observability retention beyond the default window, (2) a single packaged compliance offering to simplify security questionnaires and evidence collection, and (3) contractual SLA tiers (with credit/response windows) that map to predictable pricing. Current platform supports long-term retention via per-customer config but lacks clear pricing, entitlement gating, and contract language. Hypothesis: Offering three modular add-ons (metered observability retention tiers, a Compliance Pack subscription, and explicit SLA tiers) as purchasable entitlements will increase average deal size and reduce sales friction for enterprise deals without materially increasing churn for self-serve customers.
experiment_summary: We will run a pricing/packaging experiment across two cohorts: (A) Sales-assisted enterprise opportunities (pilot cohort) and (B) controlled web pricing surfaced to self-serve customers. Each add-on is selectable independently. Pricing proposals: (1) Observability retention: base 7d included, optional retention tiers: 30d (+$X/month per project), 90d (+$Y/month), 365d (+one-time index surcharge + $Z/month). (2) Compliance Pack: flat monthly fee + 20% uplift on data-sensitive routes; includes templated questionnaire responses, DSG evidence bundle exports, and quarterly compliance review. (3) SLA tiers: Standard (no credits), Silver (99.9% uptime, 2 hr incident response SLA, credit up to 10%), Gold (99.95%, 1 hr response, 25% credit) — priced as percentage uplift on committed capacity or flat premium for hosted API. Pricing sensitivity will be A/B tested in negotiated deals and via a limited set of quoting flows in the Console.
gating_and_implementation_notes: Entitlements will be implemented as Console feature flags + billing metadata. Legal/Finance need term templates for each add-on and a standard clause for data egress/retention in the compliance pack. Engineering to add: billing dimension for retention tier, telemetry tags to attribute revenue and cost per-customer retention, API for exporting compliance evidence, and SLA telemetry and incident tagging to support credits. Short-term gating: feature-level entitlement toggles per account and per-route restrictions for compliance-sensitive customers.
success_metrics: Primary: delta in average ARR per won enterprise deal (target +18%), increase in conversion velocity for enterprise prospects (target -10 days), attach rate for add-ons among pilot customers (target >= 35%). Secondary: per-customer cost delta (observability storage cost vs price), NPS change for pilot cohort, reduction in security questionnaire back-and-forth time (target -40%) as reported by SEs.
rollout_plan: Week 1 (design & legal): finalize product definition, pricing bands, and contract language. Week 2 (engineering): expose entitlement flags, billing dimension prototype, and compliance evidence export API. Week 3 (pilot): enable for 5 committed pilot customers via Solutions Engineering; collect conversion and usage telemetry. Week 4-6 (iterate): adjust pricing ranges and gating rules based on feedback. Week 7: open limited self-serve offering behind a gated pricing page and quote flow. Sales enablement materials and updated playbooks to be delivered prior to commercial launch.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Storage cost for long retention materially exceeds price — mitigate with tiered pricing and a one-time ingestion/index surcharge. Risk: Compliance Pack scope ambiguity causes legal churn — mitigate with a clear, scannable compliance checklist and sample evidence bundle. Risk: SLA credits are abused — mitigate with a clear incident taxonomy, uptime measurement methodology, and a max credit cap in contract terms.
engineering_work_items: Implement evidence export endpoint and template (ENG-2445)
SLA telemetry hooks and credit calculation service (ENG-2459)
Console UI: pricing selector + quote generator (ENG-2473)
acceptance_criteria: 1) Entitlement flags exist and are togglable per account. 2) Billing reports show retention tier revenue and storage costs broken out. 3) Compliance evidence export produces the templated bundle for pilot customers. 4) Pilot customers can select add-ons via the Console and receive correct billing. 5) Legal attaches add-on clauses to pilot MSA amendments.
